body.name: \(\operatorname{Eval}(C,p)\)
body.construction: Return \(\mathsf{infeasible}\) if exact real quantifier elimination finds \(\mathcal F_0(p)=\varnothing\); return \(\mathsf{undefined\mbox{-}zero\mbox{-}denominator}\) if \(\mathcal F_0(p)\ne\varnothing\) and \(\mathcal F_+(p)=\varnothing\); otherwise verify the circuit divisor at \(p\) and return \(C(p)\). Models in \(\mathcal F_0(p)\setminus\mathcal F_+(p)\) have no conditional target and do not enter the identification quantifier.
